critical_code_review_comments: Bulk upload lowercases emails (str(row['email']).strip().lower()) but user docs/templates show uppercase-friendly emails. This could cause confusion when admins search for users by email - stored as lowercase. Minor inconsistency worth documenting.
AdminLayout.js: 'nav-reports-&-analytics' data-testid has '&' in it which is unusual for testids (CSS selectors may need escaping). Not blocking but worth normalizing.
